# Gong

> Gong is the #1 Revenue AI Operating System (Revenue AI OS) for B2B go-to-market teams. Gong captures and analyzes customer interactions across calls, emails, and web conferencing, then uses AI to deliver actionable insights that help revenue teams improve sales execution, forecast accurately, coach reps, and grow predictably. Trusted by 5,000+ customers including Fortune 10 companies, Gong is recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave™ for Revenue Orchestration Platforms and a Leader in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Revenue Action Orchestration.

Gong was co-founded by CEO Amit Bendov and CPO Eilon Reshef. The company was built to solve a fundamental problem: revenue leaders were making decisions based on guesswork rather than what customers were actually saying. Gong uses proprietary AI models trained on billions of sales interactions to analyze every customer touchpoint — calls, emails, meetings, and CRM data — and turn them into actionable intelligence.

Key concepts:
- **Revenue AI OS**: Gong's unified platform where humans, AI agents, and tools work together to optimize revenue outcomes across the entire customer lifecycle.
- **Gong Revenue Graph**: A living network of revenue data that automatically captures and connects every customer interaction across a business — the data foundation powering all of Gong's AI.
- **Gong Agents**: Specialized AI agents (AI Tasker, AI Deal Monitor, AI Tracker, AI Deal Predictor, and others) that automate follow-ups, pipeline edits, enablement triggers, and forecast corrections.
- **Gong Collective**: The integration and partner ecosystem with 250+ integrations including Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Slack, and more.
- **Revenue Intelligence**: A category Gong pioneered in 2019 — technology that automatically captures customer interactions, analyzes them with AI, and surfaces insights to drive winning outcomes across the entire go-to-market organization.
- **Conversation Intelligence**: Gong's foundational capability — recording, transcribing, and analyzing sales calls and meetings to surface coaching opportunities, deal risks, and buyer signals.
- **Gong Labs**: Gong's data research team that analyzes tens of millions of sales interactions and publishes data-backed findings on what separates top sellers from the rest.

Gong serves sales reps, sales leaders, revenue operations, customer success, and enablement teams across technology/SaaS, financial services, healthcare, and manufacturing industries. The platform supports multilingual capabilities across global markets and integrates with CRMs, communication platforms, and 250+ other tools. The company employs over 20 in-house AI models trained specifically for revenue workflows.

## Platform & Core Products

- [Revenue AI OS Overview](https://www.gong.io/platform): Complete platform overview — where humans, agents, and tools work together to optimize revenue outcomes
- [Gong Engage (Sales Engagement)](https://www.gong.io/platform/sales-engagement-software): AI-powered sales engagement for prioritizing and personalizing every prospect interaction, from first touch to closed-won
- [Gong Forecast (Revenue Forecasting)](https://www.gong.io/platform/revenue-forecasting-software): Forecast accuracy and pipeline analytics with unbiased, AI-driven insights and centralized analytics
- [Gong Enable (Sales Enablement)](https://www.gong.io/platform/sales-enablement-software): Revenue enablement grounded in real customer interactions — onboard and coach reps with AI Trainer and real call libraries
- [Gong Revenue Graph](https://www.gong.io/platform/revenue-graph): The data foundation that automatically captures and connects every customer interaction across a business
- [Gong Revenue AI](https://www.gong.io/platform/revenue-ai): Details on Gong's proprietary AI models and how they power the platform — over 20 in-house models trained on billions of interactions
- [Gong AI Agents](https://www.gong.io/platform/ai-agents-for-revenue-teams): Specialized AI agents (AI Tasker, AI Deal Monitor, AI Tracker, AI Deal Predictor) that automate grunt work across the revenue workflow
- [Trust & Security](https://www.gong.io/platform/trust): Enterprise-grade security, globally recognized compliance standards, and strict privacy controls
- [Pricing](https://www.gong.io/pricing): Gong pricing and packaging information
- [Product Tour](https://www.gong.io/platform-tour): Interactive self-guided tour of the Gong platform
- [Innovation](https://www.gong.io/innovation): Latest product developments, AI innovations, and product roadmap highlights

## Software Category Pages

- [Conversation Intelligence Software](https://www.gong.io/conversation-intelligence): What conversation intelligence is, how Gong's CI works, and why it matters for revenue teams
- [Revenue Intelligence Software](https://www.gong.io/revenue-intelligence-software): Overview of the revenue intelligence category and how Gong's platform delivers complete pipeline visibility
- [Sales Intelligence Software](https://www.gong.io/sales-intelligence-software): How Gong transforms customer interaction data into actionable sales intelligence
- [Call Recording Software](https://www.gong.io/call-recording-software): Gong's automatic call recording across phone, video, and web — with AI analysis, compliance controls, and coaching
- [Call Transcription Software](https://www.gong.io/call-transcription-software): Automatic transcription with AI-powered topic tagging, action items, and searchable call libraries
- [Conference Call Transcription Software](https://www.gong.io/conference-call-transcription-software): Enterprise conference call capture and transcription for sales, CS, legal, and compliance teams
- [Sales Analytics Software](https://www.gong.io/actionable-sales-analytics): AI-powered sales analytics for pipeline visibility, deal risk detection, and forecasting accuracy
- [Revenue Intelligence (Category Overview)](https://www.gong.io/revenue-intelligence): What revenue intelligence is, why Gong pioneered the category, and how it works

## Solutions by Role

- [Revenue Leadership](https://www.gong.io/solutions/revenue-leadership): How CROs and VPs of Sales use Gong for strategic decision-making, forecast accuracy, and team performance
- [Revenue Operations](https://www.gong.io/solutions/revenue-operations): How RevOps teams use Gong for pipeline management, forecasting, data hygiene, and cross-functional alignment
- [Sales Teams](https://www.gong.io/solutions/sales): How individual sellers and AEs use Gong to win more deals with coaching, deal intelligence, and AI-assisted workflows
- [Customer Success](https://www.gong.io/solutions/customer-success): How CS teams use Gong for retention, expansion, churn risk detection, and seamless handoffs from sales
- [Revenue Enablement](https://www.gong.io/solutions/revenue-enablement): How enablement teams onboard and coach reps with AI Trainer, call libraries, and methodology tracking

## Solutions by Industry

- [Technology & SaaS](https://www.gong.io/solutions/tech): How SaaS and hardware providers turn every signal into a competitive edge with Gong
- [Financial Services](https://www.gong.io/solutions/financial-services): Secure, compliant revenue AI transformation for banks, insurance, and fintech organizations
- [Healthcare](https://www.gong.io/solutions/healthcare): Compliant and efficient revenue AI for healthcare teams operating in a digital-first world

## Use Cases & Capabilities

- [Deal Execution](https://www.gong.io/deal-execution): How Gong helps teams execute deals — risk detection, stakeholder mapping, and deal board visibility
- [Sales Coaching & Training](https://www.gong.io/sales-training): Replicate winning techniques across your team with data-driven coaching and real call libraries
- [Strategic Initiatives](https://www.gong.io/strategic-initiatives): Drive strategic revenue initiatives like messaging rollouts, methodology adoption, and competitive plays

## Integrations & Ecosystem

- [Gong Collective (Integrations Hub)](https://collective.gong.io/): Browse 250+ integrations, partner apps, and bespoke services

- [Zoom Integration](https://collective.gong.io/integrations/zoom): Automatic call capture and analysis from Zoom meetings
- [Slack Integration](https://collective.gong.io/integrations/slack): Automated Slack notifications for Gong calls, comments, and deal alerts
- [Microsoft 365 Copilot Integration](https://collective.gong.io/integrations/microsoft-365-copilot): AI-powered workflows combining Copilot and Gong
- [Okta Integration](https://collective.gong.io/integrations/okta): User provisioning, permission management, and SSO via Okta

## API & Developer Resources

## Blog & Thought Leadership

- [Gong Blog](https://www.gong.io/blog): The #1 data-backed sales blog — product updates, revenue strategy, thought leadership, and data-driven insights
- [What is Revenue Intelligence?](https://www.gong.io/blog/what-is-revenue-intelligence): Gong's foundational explainer on the category it pioneered in 2019
